sections.heading: CUET University portal document upload guidelines.
body: University portals (DU CSAS, BHU, JNU, AU) processing CUET admission counselling require certificates in PDF format within NTA's standard 50–300 KB file band.

faq.q: What size PDF is needed for CUET admission forms?
faq.a: Category and PwD certificates generally require PDF files between 50 KB and 300 KB.
